note: Cost-per-token vs concurrency for Llama 3.3 70B (FP16) served with vLLM-style continuous batching on an 8x H100 SXM5 node, from Spheron's 2026 GPU cost-per-token benchmark. Batch size = the number of requests sharing the GPU at once. The cluster rents for 8 x $2.90/hr = $23.20/hr; cost per million tokens = clusterHourly / (tokps * 3600) * 1e6, which reproduces every published cpm to within rounding (2800 tok/s -> $2.30/M; 25 tok/s -> $258/M). gpuFloor and precisionFloor are the same benchmark's batch-256 operating points across accelerators and quantization levels. All figures as of 2026-04.
